# Product Automaton (DFA Intersection)

This notebook walks through the **product automaton** construction that builds
a DFA recognising $L(A_1) \cap L(A_2)$ from two given DFAs.  The running
example uses two automata over $\Sigma = \{a,b\}$:

**$A_1$ — "ends in $a$":**

- States: $p_0$ (initial, non-accepting), $p_1$ (accepting)
- $\delta_1(p_0,a)=p_1$, $\delta_1(p_0,b)=p_0$, $\delta_1(p_1,a)=p_1$, $\delta_1(p_1,b)=p_0$

**$A_2$ — "even number of $a$'s":**

- States: $r_0$ (initial, accepting), $r_1$ (non-accepting)
- $\delta_2(r_0,a)=r_1$, $\delta_2(r_0,b)=r_0$, $\delta_2(r_1,a)=r_0$, $\delta_2(r_1,b)=r_1$

**Product automaton:** 4 states $\{(p_0,r_0),\,(p_0,r_1),\,(p_1,r_0),\,(p_1,r_1)\}$, with accepting set $F = F_1 \times F_2 = \{(p_1,r_0)\}$.

---

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  /* Each step: explain, worklist, processed, highlight nodes in A1 (hn1) and A2 (hn2),
     visible product nodes/edges, table rows, highlight cell, active product edges */
  var STEPS = [
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 0 &mdash; Initialise.</b> The initial product state is (&delta;&#x2081;-start, &delta;&#x2082;-start) = <code>(p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;)</code>. Add it to the worklist.",
      worklist: ["(p₀,r₀)"], processed: [],
      hn1: [], hn2: [],
      showNodes: ["p0r0"], showEdges: [], showInit: true,
      rows: [], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 1 &mdash; Pop (p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;).</b> Dequeue and begin computing its transitions.",
      worklist: [], processed: [],
      hn1: ["p0"], hn2: ["r0"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0"], showEdges: [], showInit: true,
      rows: [], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 2 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;), a).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2080;,a) = p&#x2081; and &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2080;,a) = r&#x2081;. Result: <code>(p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;)</code> &mdash; new state!",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₁)"], processed: [],
      hn1: ["p0","p1"], hn2: ["r0","r1"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:null}], hc: "(p₀,r₀)|a", activeEdge: "p0r0-a"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 3 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;), b).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2080;,b) = p&#x2080; and &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2080;,b) = r&#x2080;. Result: <code>(p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;)</code> &mdash; self-loop, already known.",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₁)"], processed: [],
      hn1: ["p0"], hn2: ["r0"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"}], hc: "(p₀,r₀)|b", activeEdge: "p0r0-b"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 4 &mdash; (p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;) fully processed.</b> Both symbols handled. Move to <em>processed</em>.",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₁)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)"],
      hn1: [], hn2: [],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"}], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 5 &mdash; Pop (p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;).</b> Compute transitions from this state.",
      worklist: [], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)"],
      hn1: ["p1"], hn2: ["r1"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"}], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 6 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;), a).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2081;,a) = p&#x2081; and &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2081;,a) = r&#x2080;. Result: <code>(p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;)</code> &mdash; new state!",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₀)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)"],
      hn1: ["p1"], hn2: ["r1","r0"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:null}], hc: "(p₁,r₁)|a", activeEdge: "p1r1-a"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 7 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;), b).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2081;,b) = p&#x2080; and &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2081;,b) = r&#x2081;. Result: <code>(p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;)</code> &mdash; new state!",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₀)","(p₀,r₁)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)"],
      hn1: ["p1","p0"], hn2: ["r1"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"}], hc: "(p₁,r₁)|b", activeEdge: "p1r1-b"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 8 &mdash; (p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;) fully processed.</b> Move to <em>processed</em>.",
      worklist: ["(p₁,r₀)","(p₀,r₁)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)"],
      hn1: [], hn2: [],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"}], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 9 &mdash; Pop (p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;). Compute &delta;((p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;), a).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2081;,a) = p&#x2081;, &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2080;,a) = r&#x2081;. Result: <code>(p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;)</code> &mdash; already known.",
      worklist: ["(p₀,r₁)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)"],
      hn1: ["p1"], hn2: ["r0","r1"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"},{from:"(p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:null}], hc: "(p₁,r₀)|a", activeEdge: "p1r0-a"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 10 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;), b).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2081;,b) = p&#x2080;, &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2080;,b) = r&#x2080;. Result: <code>(p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;)</code> &mdash; already known.",
      worklist: ["(p₀,r₁)"], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)"],
      hn1: ["p1","p0"], hn2: ["r0"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a","p1r0-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"},{from:"(p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"}], hc: "(p₁,r₀)|b", activeEdge: "p1r0-b"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 11 &mdash; Pop (p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;). Compute &delta;((p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;), a).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2080;,a) = p&#x2081;, &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2081;,a) = r&#x2080;. Result: <code>(p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;)</code> &mdash; already known.",
      worklist: [], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)","(p₁,r₀)"],
      hn1: ["p0","p1"], hn2: ["r1","r0"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a","p1r0-b","p0r1-a"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"},{from:"(p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₀,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:null}], hc: "(p₀,r₁)|a", activeEdge: "p0r1-a"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 12 &mdash; Compute &delta;((p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;), b).</b> &delta;&#x2081;(p&#x2080;,b) = p&#x2080;, &delta;&#x2082;(r&#x2081;,b) = r&#x2081;. Result: <code>(p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;)</code> &mdash; self-loop. Worklist empty &mdash; algorithm terminates.</b>",
      worklist: [], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)","(p₁,r₀)","(p₀,r₁)"],
      hn1: ["p0"], hn2: ["r1"],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a","p1r0-b","p0r1-a","p0r1-b"], showInit: true,
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"},{from:"(p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)"},{from:"(p₀,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)"}], hc: "(p₀,r₁)|b", activeEdge: "p0r1-b"
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 13 &mdash; Identify accepting states.</b> F = F&#x2081; &times; F&#x2082; = {p&#x2081;} &times; {r&#x2080;} = {(p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;)}.<br>&bull; (p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;): p&#x2080; &notin; F&#x2081; &rarr; non-accepting<br>&bull; (p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;): r&#x2081; &notin; F&#x2082; &rarr; non-accepting<br>&bull; (p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;): p&#x2081; &in; F&#x2081; AND r&#x2080; &in; F&#x2082; &rarr; <b>ACCEPTING &#x2605;</b><br>&bull; (p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;): p&#x2080; &notin; F&#x2081; &rarr; non-accepting",
      worklist: [], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)","(p₁,r₀)","(p₀,r₁)"],
      hn1: [], hn2: [],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a","p1r0-b","p0r1-a","p0r1-b"], showInit: true,
      acceptNode: "p1r0",
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)",final:false},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)",final:false},{from:"★ (p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)",final:true},{from:"(p₀,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)",final:false}], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    },
    {
      explain: "<b>Step 14 &mdash; Construction complete! &#x2713;</b> The product automaton has 4 states. Initial: (p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;). Accepting: (p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;) &#x2605;. It recognises L(A&#x2081;) &cap; L(A&#x2082;): words that end in <i>a</i> <b>and</b> have an even number of <i>a</i>'s.",
      worklist: [], processed: ["(p₀,r₀)","(p₁,r₁)","(p₁,r₀)","(p₀,r₁)"],
      hn1: [], hn2: [],
      showNodes: ["p0r0","p1r1","p1r0","p0r1"], showEdges: ["p0r0-a","p0r0-b","p1r1-a","p1r1-b","p1r0-a","p1r0-b","p0r1-a","p0r1-b"], showInit: true,
      acceptNode: "p1r0",
      rows: [{from:"(p₀,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)",final:false},{from:"(p₁,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)",final:false},{from:"★ (p₁,r₀)",a:"(p₁,r₁)",b:"(p₀,r₀)",final:true},{from:"(p₀,r₁)",a:"(p₁,r₀)",b:"(p₀,r₁)",final:false}], hc: null, activeEdge: null
    }
  ];

  var idx = 0;
  var stepBtn    = document.getElementById("pa-w1-step");
  var resetBtn   = document.getElementById("pa-w1-reset");
  var progressEl = document.getElementById("pa-w1-progress");
  var explainEl  = document.getElementById("pa-w1-explain");
  var worklistEl = document.getElementById("pa-w1-worklist");
  var procEl     = document.getElementById("pa-w1-processed");
  var tableBody  = document.getElementById("pa-w1-table-body");

  // A1 elements
  var a1Nodes = { p0: document.getElementById("pa-a1-p0"), p1: document.getElementById("pa-a1-p1") };
  // A2 elements
  var a2Nodes = { r0: document.getElementById("pa-a2-r0"), r1: document.getElementById("pa-a2-r1") };

  // Product nodes
  var prodNodes = {
    p0r0: document.getElementById("pa-prod-p0r0"),
    p0r1: document.getElementById("pa-prod-p0r1"),
    p1r0: document.getElementById("pa-prod-p1r0"),
    p1r1: document.getElementById("pa-prod-p1r1")
  };

  // Product edges (path + label pairs)
  var prodEdges = {
    "p0r0-a": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p0r0-a"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p0r0-a")],
    "p0r0-b": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p0r0-b"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p0r0-b")],
    "p1r1-a": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p1r1-a"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p1r1-a")],
    "p1r1-b": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p1r1-b"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p1r1-b")],
    "p1r0-a": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p1r0-a"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p1r0-a")],
    "p1r0-b": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p1r0-b"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p1r0-b")],
    "p0r1-a": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p0r1-a"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p0r1-a")],
    "p0r1-b": [document.getElementById("pa-prod-e-p0r1-b"), document.getElementById("pa-prod-el-p0r1-b")]
  };

  var prodInit = document.getElementById("pa-prod-init");
  var prodP1r0Outer = document.getElementById("pa-prod-p1r0-outer");

  function badges(el, items, cls) {
    el.innerHTML = "";
    if (!items.length) {
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "sc-badge-empty"; s.textContent = "∅";
      el.appendChild(s);
    } else {
      items.forEach(function(it) {
        var b = document.createElement("span");
        b.className = "sc-badge " + cls; b.textContent = it;
        el.appendChild(b);
      });
    }
  }

  function renderTable(rows, hc) {
    tableBody.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(row) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (row.final === true) tr.className = "final-row";
      var tdS = document.createElement("td"); tdS.textContent = row.from;
      var tdA = document.createElement("td"); tdA.textContent = row.a || "—";
      if (hc === row.from + "|a" || (row.final && hc === "★ " + row.from + "|a")) tdA.className = "highlight";
      /* match hc against the from field exactly */
      var fromKey = row.from.replace("★ ", "");
      if (hc === fromKey + "|a") tdA.className = "highlight";
      var tdB = document.createElement("td"); tdB.textContent = row.b || "—";
      if (hc === fromKey + "|b") tdB.className = "highlight";
      tr.append(tdS, tdA, tdB);
      tableBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function render() {
    var s = STEPS[idx];
    progressEl.textContent = "Step " + idx + " / " + (STEPS.length - 1);
    explainEl.innerHTML = s.explain;
    badges(worklistEl, s.worklist, "worklist");
    badges(procEl, s.processed, "processed");
    renderTable(s.rows, s.hc);

    // Highlight A1 nodes
    ["p0","p1"].forEach(function(n) {
      a1Nodes[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (s.hn1.indexOf(n) >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    });
    // Highlight A2 nodes
    ["r0","r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      a2Nodes[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (s.hn2.indexOf(n) >= 0 ? " active" : "");
    });

    // Product nodes visibility
    ["p0r0","p0r1","p1r0","p1r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      var visible = s.showNodes.indexOf(n) >= 0;
      var isAccept = s.acceptNode === n;
      prodNodes[n].className.baseVal = "pa-prod-node" + (visible ? "" : " hidden") + (isAccept ? " accept" : "");
    });

    // Show accept ring on (p1,r0)
    if (s.acceptNode === "p1r0") {
      prodP1r0Outer.setAttribute("stroke", "#2a9d5c");
    } else {
      prodP1r0Outer.setAttribute("stroke", "transparent");
    }

    // Product edges visibility + active
    Object.keys(prodEdges).forEach(function(key) {
      var pair = prodEdges[key];
      var visible = s.showEdges.indexOf(key) >= 0;
      var isActive = s.activeEdge === key;
      pair[0].className.baseVal = "pa-prod-edge" + (visible ? "" : " hidden") + (isActive ? " active" : "");
      pair[0].setAttribute("marker-end", isActive ? "url(#pa-prod-arrow-red)" : "url(#pa-prod-arrow)");
      pair[1].className.baseVal = "pa-prod-edge-label" + (visible ? "" : " hidden");
    });

    // Initial arrow
    prodInit.className.baseVal = "pa-prod-edge" + (s.showInit ? "" : " hidden");

    stepBtn.disabled = idx >= STEPS.length - 1;
    resetBtn.disabled = idx === 0;
  }

  stepBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { if (idx < STEPS.length - 1) { idx++; render(); } });
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() { idx = 0; render(); });
  render();
})();
</script>
```

---

## Widget 2: Word Simulation

Type a word over $\{a,b\}$ (default `aab`) and step through it on all three
automata simultaneously: $A_1$, $A_2$, and the product.  The **invariant**:
the product state always equals $(A_1\text{ state},\, A_2\text{ state})$.

```{=html}
<div class="sc-lab" id="pa-w2-lab">
  <div class="sc-field">
    <label for="pa-w2-input">Input word over {a,b}</label>
    <input id="pa-w2-input" value="aab" spellcheck="false" inputmode="text">
  </div>
  <div class="sc-btn-row">
    <button class="sc-btn" id="pa-w2-step">Step &#x2192;</button>
    <button class="sc-btn alt" id="pa-w2-reset">Reset</button>
    <span class="sc-progress" id="pa-w2-progress"></span>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-three-graphs">
    <!-- A1 -->
    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">

          </marker>

        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 120 80 L 216 80" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a1-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="162" y="73">a</text>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 222 108 L 126 108" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a1-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="162" y="127">b</text>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 232 66 C 198 5, 300 5, 266 66" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a1-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="240" y="14">a</text>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="pa-w2-a1-p0" transform="translate(96,90)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">p&#x2080;</text>
        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="pa-w2-a1-p1" transform="translate(250,90)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">p&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <!-- A2 -->
    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>A&#x2082; &mdash; even # of <i>a</i>'s</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 340 180" role="img" aria-label="A2 simulation">
        <defs>
          <marker id="pa-w2a2-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <line x1="20" y1="90" x2="62" y2="90" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a2-arrow)"/>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 80 66 C 46 5, 148 5, 114 66" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="88" y="14">b</text>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 120 80 L 216 80" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="162" y="73">a</text>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 222 108 L 126 108" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="162" y="127">a</text>
        <path class="sc-nfa-edge" d="M 232 66 C 198 5, 300 5, 266 66" marker-end="url(#pa-w2a2-arrow)"/>
        <text class="sc-nfa-edge-label" x="240" y="14">b</text>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="pa-w2-a2-r0" transform="translate(96,90)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#30bced" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>

        </g>
        <g class="sc-nfa-node" id="pa-w2-a2-r1" transform="translate(250,90)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="5">r&#x2081;</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <!-- Product -->
    <div class="sc-graph-wrap">
      <h4>Product &mdash; A&#x2081; &cap; A&#x2082;</h4>
      <svg style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;" viewBox="0 0 340 340" role="img" aria-label="Product simulation">
        <defs>
          <marker id="pa-w2p-arrow" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
            <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L8,3 z" fill="#303036"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <!-- Layout: (p0,r0)@(90,80) (p0,r1)@(250,80) (p1,r0)@(90,260) (p1,r1)@(250,260) -->
        <line x1="20" y1="80" x2="56" y2="80" stroke="#303036" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <!-- (p0,r0) self-loop b -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 74 56 C 40 -5, 142 -5, 108 56" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="82" y="4">b</text>
        <!-- (p0,r0) -> (p1,r1) a diagonal -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 114 96 L 226 244" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="178" y="162">a</text>
        <!-- (p0,r1) self-loop b -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 234 56 C 200 -5, 302 -5, 268 56" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="242" y="4">b</text>
        <!-- (p0,r1) -> (p1,r0) a diagonal -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 226 96 L 114 244" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="152" y="182">a</text>
        <!-- (p1,r1) -> (p1,r0) a horizontal -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 222 252 L 118 252" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="164" y="245">a</text>
        <!-- (p1,r1) -> (p0,r1) b vertical -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 260 232 L 260 108" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="268" y="170">b</text>
        <!-- (p1,r0) -> (p1,r1) a horizontal -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 118 268 L 222 268" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="164" y="288">a</text>
        <!-- (p1,r0) -> (p0,r0) b vertical -->
        <path class="pa-prod-edge" d="M 80 232 L 80 108" marker-end="url(#pa-w2p-arrow)"/>
        <text class="pa-prod-edge-label" x="58" y="170">b</text>
        <!-- Nodes -->
        <g class="pa-prod-node" id="pa-w2-prod-p0r0" transform="translate(90,80)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="4" font-size="11">(p&#x2080;,r&#x2080;)</text>
        </g>
        <g class="pa-prod-node" id="pa-w2-prod-p0r1" transform="translate(250,80)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="4" font-size="11">(p&#x2080;,r&#x2081;)</text>
        </g>
        <g class="pa-prod-node" id="pa-w2-prod-p1r0" transform="translate(90,260)">
          <circle r="34" fill="none" stroke="#2a9d5c" stroke-width="1.5"></circle>
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="4" font-size="11">(p&#x2081;,r&#x2080;)</text>
        </g>
        <g class="pa-prod-node" id="pa-w2-prod-p1r1" transform="translate(250,260)">
          <circle r="28"></circle>
          <text text-anchor="middle" dy="4" font-size="11">(p&#x2081;,r&#x2081;)</text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel" style="margin-top:0;">
    <h4>Simulation Trace</h4>
    <table class="sc-table">
      <thead><tr><th>Prefix</th><th>A&#x2081; state</th><th>A&#x2082; state</th><th>Product state</th><th>A&#x2081; acc?</th><th>A&#x2082; acc?</th><th>Product acc?</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody id="pa-w2-trace"></tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="margin-top:10px;font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--sc-label);" id="pa-w2-invariant"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // A1: ends in a
  // delta1(p0,a)=p1, delta1(p0,b)=p0, delta1(p1,a)=p1, delta1(p1,b)=p0
  var delta1 = { p0: { a: "p1", b: "p0" }, p1: { a: "p1", b: "p0" } };
  var f1 = { p1: true };

  // A2: even number of a's
  // delta2(r0,a)=r1, delta2(r0,b)=r0, delta2(r1,a)=r0, delta2(r1,b)=r1
  var delta2 = { r0: { a: "r1", b: "r0" }, r1: { a: "r0", b: "r1" } };
  var f2 = { r0: true };

  function fmtP(s) { return s === "p0" ? "p₀" : "p₁"; }
  function fmtR(s) { return s === "r0" ? "r₀" : "r₁"; }
  function fmtProd(p, r) { return "(" + fmtP(p) + "," + fmtR(r) + ")"; }

  function sanitize(v) { return v.toLowerCase().replace(/[^ab]/g, ""); }

  var inputEl    = document.getElementById("pa-w2-input");
  var stepBtn    = document.getElementById("pa-w2-step");
  var resetBtn   = document.getElementById("pa-w2-reset");
  var progressEl = document.getElementById("pa-w2-progress");
  var explainEl  = document.getElementById("pa-w2-explain");
  var trackEl    = document.getElementById("pa-w2-track");
  var traceEl    = document.getElementById("pa-w2-trace");
  var invEl      = document.getElementById("pa-w2-invariant");

  // Graph nodes
  var a1p0 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-a1-p0");
  var a1p1 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-a1-p1");
  var a2r0 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-a2-r0");
  var a2r1 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-a2-r1");
  var prodP0r0 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-prod-p0r0");
  var prodP0r1 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-prod-p0r1");
  var prodP1r0 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-prod-p1r0");
  var prodP1r1 = document.getElementById("pa-w2-prod-p1r1");

  var a1Map = { p0: a1p0, p1: a1p1 };
  var a2Map = { r0: a2r0, r1: a2r1 };
  var prodMap = {
    "p0-r0": prodP0r0, "p0-r1": prodP0r1,
    "p1-r0": prodP1r0, "p1-r1": prodP1r1
  };

  var symIdx, curP, curR, rows;

  function renderTrack(word) {
    trackEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (!word.length) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym"; sp.textContent = "ε";
      trackEl.appendChild(sp); return;
    }
    word.split("").forEach(function(c, i) {
      var sp = document.createElement("span");
      sp.className = "sc-sym" + (i === symIdx ? " current" : "");
      sp.textContent = c; trackEl.appendChild(sp);
    });
  }

  function renderTrace() {
    traceEl.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(r, i) {
      var tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (i === rows.length - 1) tr.style.fontWeight = "bold";
      [r.prefix, r.a1, r.a2, r.prod, r.a1acc, r.a2acc, r.pacc].forEach(function(v) {
        var td = document.createElement("td"); td.textContent = v; tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      traceEl.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function applyGraphs(p, r) {
    // A1
    ["p0","p1"].forEach(function(n) {
      a1Map[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (n === p ? " active" : "");
    });
    // A2
    ["r0","r1"].forEach(function(n) {
      a2Map[n].className.baseVal = "sc-nfa-node" + (n === r ? " active" : "");
    });
    // Product
    Object.keys(prodMap).forEach(function(k) {
      var active = k === p + "-" + r;
      prodMap[k].className.baseVal = "pa-prod-node" + (active ? " active" : "");
    });
  }

  function accStr(b) { return b ? "✅ Yes" : "❌ No"; }

  function reset() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (word !== inputEl.value) inputEl.value = word;
    symIdx = 0; curP = "p0"; curR = "r0";
    var a1acc = !!f1[curP]; var a2acc = !!f2[curR]; var pacc = a1acc && a2acc;
    rows = [{ prefix: "ε", a1: fmtP(curP), a2: fmtR(curR), prod: fmtProd(curP, curR), a1acc: accStr(a1acc), a2acc: accStr(a2acc), pacc: accStr(pacc) }];
    explainEl.innerHTML = "<b>Initialised.</b> A₁ in " + fmtP(curP) + ", A₂ in " + fmtR(curR) + ", product in " + fmtProd(curP, curR) + ".";
    invEl.textContent = "Invariant: product state " + fmtProd(curP, curR) + " = (" + fmtP(curP) + ", " + fmtR(curR) + ") ✓";
    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol 0 / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyGraphs(curP, curR);
    stepBtn.disabled = word.length === 0;
  }

  function step() {
    var word = sanitize(inputEl.value);
    if (symIdx >= word.length) return;
    var sym = word[symIdx];
    var prevP = curP; var prevR = curR;
    curP = delta1[prevP][sym];
    curR = delta2[prevR][sym];
    symIdx++;

    var a1acc = !!f1[curP]; var a2acc = !!f2[curR]; var pacc = a1acc && a2acc;
    var prefix = word.slice(0, symIdx);
    rows.push({ prefix: prefix, a1: fmtP(curP), a2: fmtR(curR), prod: fmtProd(curP, curR), a1acc: accStr(a1acc), a2acc: accStr(a2acc), pacc: accStr(pacc) });

    explainEl.innerHTML =
      "<b>Read ‘" + sym + "’.</b> " +
      "A₁: " + fmtP(prevP) + " → " + fmtP(curP) + ". " +
      "A₂: " + fmtR(prevR) + " → " + fmtR(curR) + ". " +
      "Product: " + fmtProd(prevP, prevR) + " → " + fmtProd(curP, curR) + ". " +
      (pacc ? "<b>Accepted ✅</b>" : "Not accepted ❌");

    invEl.textContent = "Invariant: product state " + fmtProd(curP, curR) + " = (" + fmtP(curP) + ", " + fmtR(curR) + ") ✓";
    progressEl.textContent = "Symbol " + symIdx + " / " + word.length;
    renderTrack(word); renderTrace();
    applyGraphs(curP, curR);
    stepBtn.disabled = symIdx >= word.length;

    if (symIdx >= word.length) {
      explainEl.innerHTML +=
        "<br><b>Word fully consumed.</b> A₁ " + (a1acc ? "accepts" : "rejects") +
        ", A₂ " + (a2acc ? "accepts" : "rejects") +
        ". Product: <b>" + (pacc ? "ACCEPTED ✅" : "REJECTED ❌") + "</b>";
    }
  }

  inputEl.addEventListener("input", reset);
  stepBtn.addEventListener("click", step);
  resetBtn.addEventListener("click", reset);
  reset();
})();
</script>
```

---

## What To Notice

1. **The product state is always the pair of component states — no information
   is lost or added.**
   At every moment in Widget 2 the product state equals
   $(\text{A}_1\text{ state},\,\text{A}_2\text{ state})$.  The product
   construction simply runs both automata in lock-step and packages the two
   states into one.

2. **Only $(p_1,r_0)$ is accepting: the word must end in $a$ AND have an even
   count of $a$'s.**
   Acceptance in the product requires membership in $F_1 \times F_2$, i.e.\
   the current state must be accepting in *both* components simultaneously.

3. **The word "a" reaches $(p_1,r_1)$ — ends in $a$ but odd count — rejected.**
   One condition is met ($A_1$ accepts) but the other fails ($A_2$ rejects),
   so the product rejects.  Try it in Widget 2.

4. **The word "aa" reaches $(p_1,r_0)$ — accepted by both conditions.**
   Two $a$'s give an even count and the word ends in $a$.
   This is the simplest accepted word.
